announcements.headline: Annual Reports and Accounts
announcements.insight: Nanoco Group publishes its final results following the November notice. This completes the scheduled annual reporting cycle for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Final results follow the August trading update. Shareholders should review the outcomes to assess performance against earlier guidance.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results
announcements.insight: Nanoco Group issues a notice of results following its August trading update. Shareholders should await the full financial details to assess performance.

announcements.headline: Full Year Trading Update
announcements.insight: Nanoco Group issued a full year trading update following recent board updates and shareholder consultations. Shareholders should monitor subsequent developments regarding the company's strategic direction.

announcements.headline: PDMR Shareholding and Deferred Bonus Options
announcements.insight: Director dealings are reported following recent board updates and shareholder consultations. This reflects standard governance compliance rather than a strategic shift.

announcements.headline: Commencement of Shareholder Consultation
announcements.insight: Following the May delist intention and June adjournments, this consultation seeks shareholder support to advance the removal from the London Stock Exchange.

announcements.headline: Board Update
announcements.insight: Board changes follow the June adjournment of the General Meeting. This suggests ongoing governance shifts amid the planned delist.

announcements.headline: Adjournment of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The adjournment of the General Meeting follows the May delist intention and June Glass Lewis recommendation, indicating a delay in the proposed exit process.

announcements.headline: Intention to adjourn General Meeting
announcements.insight: The General Meeting is adjourned following the May delist intention and June Glass Lewis recommendation. Shareholders should watch for the rescheduled meeting date to determine the outcome of the proposed exit.

announcements.headline: Glass Lewis recommendation
announcements.insight: Glass Lewis recommends a stance on the delist from London Stock Exchange announced in May. Shareholders should monitor how this recommendation influences the final outcome of the removal process.

announcements.headline: Intention to delist from London Stock Exchange
announcements.insight: Nanoco Group intends to delist from the London Stock Exchange. This action removes shares from public trading, significantly altering liquidity and access for existing shareholders.
